description:
ReachabilityCalculator::visit (src/compiler2/dispatch_reachability.rs:157) clones the ReachabilityState (two vectors, lines 140/141, ~8,600 allocations) to probe the visited set on every visit, including revisits, although it already receives the state as a Cow.

Change: probe the visited set with the borrowed state and copy (or move the owned Cow) only on first visit; an Outcome node moves its roots out as it does now. Confirm the revisit ratio first; if nearly every visit is a first visit and the state is then cloned again downstream, report that instead.

Evidence: allocation census of the OptionParser probe at bf51f11c1 (develop ac3750d1e + hasher fix + fz-y11.15 spike; 857,327 calls). Ranked sites: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/464fcf92-8f92-4767-a8fb-4e4eea4b6d45/scratchpad/census/bf51f11c1_top.txt; call chains: python3 /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/464fcf92-8f92-4767-a8fb-4e4eea4b6d45/scratchpad/census/chain.py /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/464fcf92-8f92-4767-a8fb-4e4eea4b6d45/scratchpad/census/bf51f11c1.pkl <file:line> <depth>. Counts are 1-in-16 sampling estimates; line numbers are at that commit. Method and signal: see the epic (bw show fz-y11). Every site is a claim read from the census and the source, to be confirmed first.
title: Dispatch reachability copies a state only when it is new
